name: Flex Your FPS And Ping!
desc:
Welcome to Flex Your FPS And Ping!

This is a simple hangout game with a twist! Your FPS is publically displayed above your head, completely exposing your device's performance!

Find out what your MAX FPS is! : https://www.roblox.com/games/6438993656/What-Is-Your-Highest-Fps

Play my newest projects! : 
https://www.roblox.com/games/133562652943637/Subwae
https://www.roblox.com/games/91442857444339/The-platform-showcase

Heads up: Your FPS will not display any higher than 240 if you do not have an fps unlocker on, look up how to get one!
